messages:
deploybot: Releasecheck FAILED — env parity mismatch: LOG_LEVEL vs staging/prod types. Blocking rollout.

deploybot: details: staging="info" (string), prod=info (unquoted value in Helm) but templated as map in new chart. Affected: /services/worker/helm/values.yaml and /services/worker/config/defaults.yaml.

tara: saw canary fail earlier, screenshots show worker crashed on config parse error. Likely recent chart refactor.

omar: i merged a chart cleanup yesterday that moved LOG_LEVEL under logging: level: in values. maybe the template expects a map not scalar now.

cheng: paste the failing template error?

deploybot: template render error: cannot convert mapping to string at .Values.logging.level

omar: ok that matches. my refactor accidentally changed values schema. we need either to revert the chart change or adapt the config generator that flattens env.

tara: given we're in the middle of a change window, revert feels lower risk. is the chart change behind a specific PR?

omar: PR #4567. I can open a revert and pin chart to helm-chart@v2.3.1 for the release.

release-coordinator: revert preferred. please include release note explaining: "Reverted logging values schema refactor to preserve env parser compatibility; pinned chart to v2.3.1." Also include rollout window note.

sre-oncall: agree. we can pause promotion for 1h while revert lands, but don't relax runtime parse checks.

omar: revert PR opened: #4570. includes small compatibility test to ensure logging.level renders as scalar.

tara: any secret paths touched? deploybot showed only values and defaults files. quick grep shows LOG_SECRET_PATH unchanged.

cheng: will follow up tomorrow to make the chart refactor backward-compatible with an upgrade shim and to add a deploycheck that validates values schema before promotion.

deploybot: action: release-window paused by @sre-oncall at 1750012360. Canary blocked.

omar: revert merged at 1750012389, CI passed.

sre-oncall: resuming rollout at 1750012396. monitoring logs and error rate.

deploybot: Canary promoted after 3 successful cycles. Block resolved.

release-coordinator: post-release tasks: add schema validation to preflight checks, update release checklist to verify chart schema compatibility when refactoring, owner = cheng/omar.

tara: adding quick note to changelog. :memo:
